steps: Launch Valheim 1.0 or later and create or load any world.
Spawn in as a new Viking — the achievement fires the first time you enter the world.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Achievement tracking only began when Valheim 1.0 launched on 9 September 2026 — every boss kill and statistic from Early Access is ignored, so old saves must be replayed.
Reddit tip: Progress is per character. If your character is flagged as a cheater, no achievement will ever unlock on it.
warnings: Stats only count from the moment you install 1.0 — Early Access play history does not carry over.

achievements.name: The First of Many
achievements.description: Meet your end, then prepare to do it all again...

steps: Find any way to die in Valheim — a short fall from a rock works reliably.
Respawn at your bed or spawn point; the achievement triggers on the death itself, not the respawn.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Bank this one and the other death achievements early, while your skill levels are low — the 1.0 game files set skill loss on death to 5%, so dying is cheapest at the start.

steps: Place at least 6 floor blocks, 8 wall blocks and 4 roof blocks, plus 1 piece of furniture, 1 storage piece such as a chest, and 1 light source.
Stand inside the build while it is placed — the requirement counts pieces within the loaded zones around you, which is a 5x5 grid of 64 m zones (roughly 320 m across), not a single room.
The achievement fires once all six categories are satisfied in that loaded area.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: There is no bed requirement — a bed only counts as the single Furniture piece. Any furniture works.
Reddit tip: A build large enough to satisfy The Architect also satisfies The Homesteader, so an existing village gets this for free.
warnings: Popular community guides omit the lighting requirement — the game files and official wiki both require 1 light source, so build a torch or a hearth inside.
Categories are the usage tags of the build menu, so a piece with several tags counts toward more than one category at once.

steps: Craft 2 Deer Trophies and place them on the Eikthyr altar in the Meadows.
Let Eikthyr spawn, then fight him with a bow from behind the boulders or a club at melee range.
Kill him and pick up his Forsaken Power to trigger the achievement.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Eikthyr is the easiest boss to solo, so killing him with no party members online also covers Lone Wolf in the same trip.
Reddit tip: Hit him with a longship parked on the altar to knock the deer into the sea for an instant kill, but only if you do not mind carrying the fight off the altar.

achievements.name: Stronger Together
achievements.description: Kill a boss together with a friend.

steps: Join or host a world with at least one other player connected.
Summon any boss — Eikthyr is the lowest-risk choice — while the second player is present.
Land the killing blow while that other player is still alive and participating in the fight.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The other player only needs to be connected and taking part, not dealing damage — one player can tank while the other watches.
Reddit tip: A friend can disconnect the moment before your kill lands and you will not get this one, so leave them connected until the boss dies.
warnings: Playing with a second player blocks Lone Wolf, so plan two separate boss kills if you want both.

steps: Place 40x Flooring, 40x Walls and 20x Roofing pieces within the loaded zones around you.
Then add 10x Building pieces, 10x Architecture pieces, 10x Furniture, 5x Lighting and 5x Decor.
Stand inside the settlement as you build — the counter covers a 5x5 grid of 64 m zones (roughly 320 m across) centred on you, so walk through the village to register everything.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The 5x Lighting category is the hidden bottleneck — it needs torches, lamps and similar light pieces, not just the one fixture you normally build.
Reddit tip: Because categories are usage tags, a multi-tag piece such as a roof that is also a Building counts toward several categories at once, which speeds the totals up considerably.
warnings: The description gives no numbers at all, so this is one of the more opaque requirements in the set.
Pieces do not have to be connected or pretty — but they all need to be inside the loaded zone area while you are standing there.

steps: Travel into the Black Forest and gather 3 Ancient Seeds.
Burn the 3 Ancient Seeds on the Elder's altar to summon him.
Break line of sight whenever he charges or calls in seeds, then punish him with a two-handed club or bow.
Place 500 building pieces anywhere in the world — any piece from the Hammer menu counts.
A normal base with a workshop, portal, farm and storage areas will supply most of the count.
Top up the remainder with cheap pieces such as Campfire, Workbench and fence posts.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This one fills itself during normal base building — do not grind it separately.

achievements.name: Lone Wolf
achievements.description: Kill a boss all by yourself.

steps: Play solo with no other players connected to your world.
Summon and defeat any boss — Eikthyr is the easiest, Eikthyr plus a longship is close to trivial.
Finish the kill without letting a second player join or rejoin mid-fight.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Having a friend connected blocks this achievement, so stack it with a solo Eikthyr kill before you start your co-op boss rush.
Reddit tip: Bosses can be re-summoned at their altars at any time, so you can deliberately farm easy solo kills.
warnings: Stronger Together requires another player — you cannot get both from the same kill.

steps: Explore the Swamp and bring back 10 Withered Bones.
Sacrifice the bones on Bonemass's altar to summon him.
Drink Poison Resistance Mead, then kill him with a club while ignoring the adds he spawns.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Poison Resistance Mead cuts his poison cloud damage by 75% and is the single biggest reason this fight goes from brutal to routine.
Reddit tip: The Wishbone he drops is what you use for The Treasure Hunter — kill him on a living character and keep the item.

steps: Find a tree in a biome where you are not being attacked — the Meadows work well.
Stand directly under the trunk and chop it without moving, letting the falling tree land on you.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Do this before you start The Survivor — dying resets your consecutive-day counter.

steps: Place several Cooking Stations over a single campfire so you can queue multiple dishes at once.
Cook 100 food items in total — any recipe made at a cooking station counts, and repeats are fine.
Keep cooking through normal play; this overlaps with The Master Chef and No Adventuring On an Empty Stomach.
Reach the Mountains and collect 3 Dragon Eggs, dropping them when they hatch if you need to.
Place the 3 Dragon Eggs on Moder's altar to summon her.
Fight her at range — she has almost no damaging melee and her attacks are easy to dodge with distance.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Clear nearby Drakes and Stone Golems and start during daylight, otherwise the spawns join her and the fight snowballs.
Reddit tip: A hoe-raised pillar behind you blocks her barrage almost completely.

steps: Take a ship out into the Ocean biome and find a sleeping Leviathan.
Mine the Abyssal Barnacles on its back until it wakes and starts sinking.
Stay right next to its centre and ride it all the way down — it must fully submerge, not merely start to sink.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You must fully sink it — merely damaging it or finding it does nothing, and the pre-1.0 discovery behaviour no longer applies.
Reddit tip: If it surfaces again mid-attempt the counter resets, so stay with it until you are certain it is under for good.
Reddit tip: Back up your world first — this is the one achievement with real permadeath risk and a failed attempt can cost your whole boat.

achievements.name: No Adventuring On an Empty Stomach

steps: Eat 500 food items in total — anything edible counts, including cooked meals, berries and fish.
Keep your food buff timer topped up while you play; every meal you eat for a buff counts toward the total.
Stack your farming and cooking so a single harvest feeds this achievement alongside The Cook and The Farmer.
Build a farm plot and plant a crop.
Harvest 500 crops in total — replanted and regrown crops each count, so a single field loops forever.
Harvest the whole field at once each cycle to move the counter fastest.
Enter the Plains and collect 5 Fuling Totems from Fuling villages and totems.
Place the 5 totems on Yagluth's altar to summon him.
Fight with Frost arrows or a Spirit weapon from range, and dodge his nova — a direct hit from it is close to an instant death.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Clear Fuling villages and tar pits near the altar first — they will spawn into the fight and turn a hard boss into a wipe.
Reddit tip: You can hit him and backstab freely while he is still emerging from the ground at the start of the fight.
Reddit tip: A Fenris set removes the need for Fire Resistance Barley Wine entirely.
warnings: His nova deals massive damage on direct hit — do not try to trade blows in the open.

steps: Finish every death-related achievement first, because dying resets the consecutive-day counter.
Build a fully enclosed base with beds, a fire and food, then hold position for 30 in-game days without dying.
Let the run play out — one Valheim day is roughly 30 real minutes, so expect around 15 hours of safe play.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Boats and Portal networks are the main risk — a portal or Longship trip during the streak can end 15 hours of progress instantly.
Reddit tip: Difficulty is a set of independent world modifiers you can change at runtime with setkey in the F5 console, so you can lower the death penalty during the streak.

Reddit tip: Known bug — the consecutive-day counter can get permanently locked on certain difficulties if you already earned The Survivor before the Child of Odin patch. Temporarily switching difficulty lets the counter climb again.
warnings: Any death at all resets the counter to zero — do this last, or immediately after clearing the death achievements.
This is a prerequisite for Child of Odin, so it cannot be skipped on a Hard-only run.

steps: Build a small room with a roof and a lit fire inside, since furniture only counts when sheltered and lit.

Fill it with one high-tier item per comfort category: any Throne, Dragon Bed, Round Table or Long Heavy Table, a heated Hot tub, Hearth, Bearskin or Wolf or Lox rug, a Red or Blue Jute Curtain, a Lava lantern, an Armor stand or Item stand, any Garland or Fey Lights, and Pots or an Asksvin Skeleton.
Keep adding until the readout reaches 20 — the setup above gives roughly 22, and you need everything within 10 m of you and under a roof.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Duplicates do not stack — only the highest level item in each category is used, so you need one distinct piece per category rather than volume.
Reddit tip: The Dragon Bed and Hot tub are Ashlands items, but Mistlands gear alone reaches exactly 20, so a player who has not touched the Ashlands can still just make it.
Reddit tip: The 1.0 ceiling is now 22, or 24 with seasonal pieces such as the Maypole and Yule Tree.

steps: Pick 250 berries — the counter ticks when you interact with a berry bush, not per berry in the cluster.
Pick 250 mushrooms — this counts interactions with growing mushrooms, so planting your own counts too.
Farm Cloudberries in the Plains for the berry half and plant Jotun Puffs or Magecaps from the Mistlands for the mushroom half.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You only need to touch a bush once to register progress for the whole cluster, so one walk through a Plains cloudberry patch pushes the number fast.
Reddit tip: Magecaps and Jotun Puffs can be planted and harvested repeatedly, which makes the mushroom half a short farm loop rather than a search.

steps: Clear a Winding Path or Infested Citadel in the Mistlands — the first one requires no sacrifice.
Craft a Sealbreaker and use it on the Infested Citadel door to reach the Queen.
Fight her with a bow or a Frostner, keeping distance because her spawn adds fill the arena fast.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Her adds are the real threat — bring a fire-based weapon or a shockwave staff and clear them before they surround you.
Reddit tip: You only need a Sealbreaker to enter, so the first attempt can be made as soon as you have one crafted.

steps: Read the Vegvisir that reveals the Ashlands boss location, then explore the Ashlands for Charred Fortresses.
Collect 9 Bell Fragments and craft 3 Bells.
Place the 3 Bells around Fader's altar to summon him, then fight him with a bow or a magic build.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The altar location is found through a rune read inside a Putrid Hole, the same source of two of the three Dyrnwyn fragments.
Reddit tip: Fight him with slash or blunt damage — he resists elemental damage types and punishes close-range magic users.
warnings: Ashlands heat and ash damage are as dangerous as the boss itself — bring cooling food and resist meads or you will die to the environment first.

steps: Craft a Beehive — it needs a Workbench, 10 Wood and 1 Queen Bee obtained by looting a Bee Queen nest.
Build a large cluster of beehives at your base so they produce passively.
Harvest 500 Honey in total — each hive yields roughly 1 Honey every 20 minutes and stores up to 4, so collect on a timer.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the longest passive grind in the set — build the hive cluster in the first session and it fills while you do everything else.
Reddit tip: Hives must be placed outdoors in the rain and within range of your base, so put them next to your farm rather than across the map.
warnings: Each hive caps at 4 Honey, so harvesting on a timer matters — leaving them full for days wastes a large amount of production.

achievements.name: The Captain
achievements.description: Sail far enough to circle the world, while manning the helm.

steps: Build the Longship, the fastest boat in the game, and stock it with food, a bed and a Portal.
Sail while personally sitting at the helm for a total of 65,973 m — one full lap of the world.
The distance counter only ticks while you are at the helm, so plan wide arcs instead of constant course corrections.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: One lap at the helm is 65,973 m and the world circumference works out to a 10,500 m radius, so a clean compass circuit hits the number exactly.
Reddit tip: Two laps at the helm also completes The Sailor, since that threshold is exactly double — steer the whole way and get both from one voyage.
warnings: Sailing as a passenger counts toward The Sailor but not this one — only distance covered at the helm registers here.
Steam shows no live progress for this achievement, so count laps manually using a Portal as a halfway marker.

steps: Progress through the Deep North to the Aesir Passage and collect 3 Malicious Blood.
Sacrifice the blood on the Strange Bowl altar to summon him.

Phase 1: dodge the chain combos and punish the recovery windows. Phase 2: he is immune to all damage — kill the seven Aspects he summons instead. Phase 3: a 30,000 HP endurance fight, keep your stamina up and avoid the Flurry.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: He resists Pierce, Fire, Frost and Lightning and Spirit does nothing — build slash or blunt and keep Fire and Frost resistance meads up.
Reddit tip: Watch the chain itself rather than his body when the swings come out; the chain telegraphs the direction far more clearly.
Reddit tip: Place a Portal near the Aesir Passage before you start, otherwise every death is a full trek back across the Deep North.
warnings: His three phases total roughly 47,000 HP, and Phase 2 makes attacking him pointless — killing him in one go is not realistic.
This is the final boss and the hardest fight in the game; expect several attempts.

achievements.name: The Sailor
achievements.description: Sail far enough to circle the world twice.

steps: Accumulate 131,946 m of sailing distance — exactly two full laps of the 65,973 m world circumference.
You can sail as a passenger or at the helm, so a friend can steer while you ride along.
Distance carries across voyages, so several shorter trips add up to the same total.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the single longest grind in the set — do it last so you are not sailing 132 km while still gearing up.
Reddit tip: The threshold is exactly double The Captain's, so two laps at the helm completes both achievements in one voyage.
warnings: The world edge is not a wall — veer too far out while chasing distance and you will fall into the void and lose the boat.

steps: Find the first Mysterious Location — its Vegvisir is hidden inside a Putrid Hole in the Ashlands, guarded by 2-star Charred enemies. Break a wall to enter, clear it, and take the Dyrnwyn Tip Fragment from the altar.
Read the Vegvisir at that location to reach the second Mysterious Location and collect the Blade Fragment the same way; the third location's Vegvisir then leads to the Tomb of Lord Reto.
Kill Lord Reto to drop the Hilt Fragment, then upgrade a Black Forge to level 4 and craft Dyrnwyn with the three fragments plus 20 Flametal and 1 Bloodstone.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Only the first location is located through Putrid Holes — the second and third chain off Vegvisirs found at the previous site, so follow the Vegvisir each time rather than searching for more runestones.
Reddit tip: Raising the drop multiplier before killing Lord Reto makes him drop all three of his pieces at once instead of forcing repeated runs.
Reddit tip: Killing Lord Reto also counts toward Odin is Pleased, so do it once and bank both.
warnings: Dyrnwyn is a once-per-world craft. If you burn the fragments on something else you will have to start a new world to retry.
Some databases also list a Flametal Battle Idol as a material; the base recipe confirmed by the game files and the official wiki needs only the three fragments, 20 Flametal and 1 Bloodstone.

achievements.name: The Viking
achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on any difficulty.

steps: Defeat all 8 bosses: Eikthyr, The Elder, Bonemass, Moder, Yagluth, The Seeker Queen, Fader and Kall Fimbulbringer.
All kills must be registered on the same character.
Difficulty does not matter here — do it on whatever setting you are already playing.
Any of the 12 fish species can roll 4-star — quality is decided per spawn, so pick a species that is cheap to hook rather than a rare one.
Fish with the matching bait and reel the fish in with the rod; picking one up by hand does not register.
Keep casting until a 4-star fish bites. The Plains or Swamp is the best bet at roughly a 1 in 156 spawn chance, and a 4-star fish is visibly much larger and heavier than a normal one.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Ashlands and Deep North are worse, not better — their 15% level-up chance gives only a 0.29% 4-star roll versus 0.64% in the base biomes.
Reddit tip: Grouper in the Plains on Stingy Bait or Giant Herring in the Swamp on Sticky Bait are the safest targets because they drain stamina slowly.
Reddit tip: A Fishing Hat adds 20 Fishing skill, which cuts both stamina cost and escape difficulty, so wear one.
warnings: Avoid Northern Salmon on Frosty Bait — it drains stamina at 60/s and will end most attempts before the hookup.
Magmafish require Hot Bait and sit in the lower-odds Ashlands bracket, so they are a poor target despite being high-tier.

steps: Work through the 16 death causes from the game files: enemy hit, falling, drowning, burning, freezing, poisoning, smoke, falling off the edge of the world, tree, ballista, stalactite, catapult, Ashlands ocean, the Obliterator, drawbridge and Ashlands lava.
Tick them off one at a time, checking your statistics after each death to see which cause registered.
Do this before or after The Survivor, never during a 30-day streak.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Two of the 16 are cross-credit — dying off the world edge also unlocks The Legends Are True, and dying to an Obliterator also unlocks Obliterated, so those two kills cover three achievements.
Reddit tip: The obscure ones are the Ashlands ocean, the drawbridge and the catapult — all three need you to be inside Ashlands structures rather than out in the open.
Reddit tip: Two of the sixteen cannot be forced on demand — the Frost Caves stalactite and the Ballista projectile — so leave those to chance and sweep the dungeon that has them.
warnings: Do not start this in the middle of The Survivor — any death resets the consecutive-day counter.

achievements.name: Child of Odin
achievements.description: Embody the spirits of the Toughest Viking, Master Hunter, Survivor and Pathfinder.

steps: Complete The Toughest Viking — all 8 bosses on Hard difficulty.
Complete The Master Hunter — kill every creature type on Hard, and complete The Pathfinder — reach all four world edges with the No Map modifier.
Complete The Survivor — 30 consecutive days without dying.
This one unlocks automatically once all four prerequisites are done.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the hardest capstone in the game — it forces a Hard playthrough, a full creature sweep, a no-map expedition and a 15-hour survival streak into one character.
warnings: All four prerequisites have to land on the same character, so a fresh Hard world is effectively required.
Any death during the 30-day streak resets it to zero.

achievements.name: Kings and Queens of Valheim
achievements.description: Embody the spirits of the Viking, Hunter, Artisan, Master Chef, Carpenter and the Explorer.

steps: Complete The Viking, The Hunter, The Artisan, The Master Chef and The Carpenter — the five collection and combat sweeps.
Complete The Explorer by travelling roughly 10,350 m from world centre in each of the four cardinal directions.
The achievement unlocks automatically once all six are done.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Artisan and The Master Chef are the slow part — start tracking missing recipes from the first session so you are not discovering gaps at the end.
Reddit tip: Plan The Explorer's four legs as a single sailing route and do The Pathfinder on the same trip with the No Map modifier enabled.
warnings: Nothing here can be missed, but all six prerequisites must be finished on the same character for the capstone to fire.

steps: Build upward from solid ground until a placed piece sits at least 49 m straight down from it — the drop to terrain is measured and capped at 200 m, and rocks or objects do not count as ground.
Support the column with at least 5 building pieces directly below the new piece, with more than 45% of them built by you.
Type /pos in chat to check your altitude as a reference while you climb.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the easier of the two vertical builds — a 49 m tower on flat ground is enough, whereas Top of the World needs 432 m of absolute altitude.
Reddit tip: Building over a Void or a deep mine shaft avoids terrain height limiting you while you stack.
warnings: If you build upward from a mountain peak you may satisfy Top of the World without satisfying this one, and vice versa — they track separate stats.

achievements.name: Obliterated
achievements.description: You stood a bit too close.

steps: Craft and place an Obliterator somewhere safe away from your main base.
Put an item in it and pull the lever to trigger its lightning strike.
Stand close enough to the strike to be killed by the explosion.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Place it on a platform over the ocean or a Void so the explosion does not wreck your base along with you.

steps: Kill Brenna in the Smouldering Tomb in the Black Forest, and Geirrhafa in the Howling Cavern in the Mountains.
Kill Zil and Thungr in the Sealed Tower in the Plains — the two of them share one bronze chest but count as two separate minibosses.
Kill Lord Reto in the Tomb of Lord Reto in the Ashlands. That is five miniboss requirements in total and the achievement fires once all are down.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Zil and Thungr look like one encounter but register as two, so killing both halves is required — many players miss this and stall on the last point.
Reddit tip: Lord Reto also drops the Dyrnwyn Hilt Fragment, so kill him before you assemble Dyrnwyn.
Reddit tip: Brenna can also be fought during the She's hot on your tail event in the Ashlands if you would rather skip the tomb.
warnings: The eight dungeon bosses from Eikthyr to Kall Fimbulbringer do not count here — they are tracked separately under The Viking and its variants.
There are no Deep North or Mistlands minibosses in the requirement list, so do not go looking for one there.

achievements.name: That Can't Be an Accident
achievements.description: Get killed by every kind of tree.

steps: Get killed by each of the 10 tree types: Fir, Oak, Pine, Ashlands Tree, Yggdrasil Shoot, Swamp Tree, Beech, Birch, Snow Fir and Snow Pine.
The two Deep North trees are both named Timber Tree in game, so die to each visually distinct one to register both.
Check your statistics after each death to confirm the new tree type was recorded.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Eight of the ten are in the base biomes you pass constantly — save the two Deep North trees for the same trip as Kall Fimbulbringer.
Reddit tip: These deaths also count toward Are You Alright?, so batch them early instead of repeating the trips.
warnings: Two trees share the Timber Tree name but are separate entries — dying to only one of them leaves the achievement stuck at 9/10.

steps: Save this for late game, when every crafting station and material tier is available.
Craft one of every item in the game — the full list runs to several hundred entries once plants and variants are included.
Track what is missing against a checklist spreadsheet from the first session so you do not discover gaps at the end.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Apart from the Torch, The Artisan already covers every weapon required for The Blacksmith — do Blacksmith second and it pops instantly.
Reddit tip: Place structures count separately from items, so The Carpenter does not cover this and both need real work.
warnings: This is one of the longest checklists in the game and several late-game recipes need Ashlands and Deep North materials.

steps: Craft one of every weapon type in the game — melee, bows, crossbows, siege and magic weapons.
Do this as part of The Artisan sweep rather than separately, since the Artisan list already includes every weapon.
Make sure you include the Torch, which is the one weapon the Artisan does not cover.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Craft The Artisan last and this unlocks within seconds of finishing it — doing the two separately is wasted work.
Reddit tip: Crossbows, ballista and siege weapons live in different menus than melee, and it is easy to miss them in a first pass.

steps: Build every piece available in the Hammer's build menu — the extracted list runs to 549 entries including plants, variants and seasonal pieces.
Repair the required pieces at a Workbench as well — the game files indicate each required piece needs repairing at least once.
Once each piece has been built and repaired you can dismantle them all and reclaim the materials.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Build one of everything in a throwaway test world far from your base, then dismantle — it saves fumbling with 549 pieces inside your real build.
Reddit tip: Crafting the piece is not enough; the piece has to actually be placed in the world.
warnings: Repairing is required and easy to forget, because it is not a building action. Sources differ on whether every required piece must be repaired or just one, so repair them all to be safe.
Pieces are tracked by name, so variants that share a name — the three Yggdrasil Yuleklapp, for example — only count once.

achievements.name: The Explorer
achievements.description: Travel far in all four directions.

steps: Build the Longship and stock it with food, a bed and a Portal for the return trip.
Reach a position past 10,350 m and before -10,350 m on both axes — about 150 m short of the world edge, close to each cardinal point.
Repeat for all four cardinal directions; each direction is tracked separately, so partial progress carries over.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Do this on the same trip as The Pathfinder with the No Map modifier enabled — one expedition covers both.
Reddit tip: Two Portals, one on each side of the map, turn each return leg from a long sail into an instant trip.
warnings: The counting band is only about 150 m wide between 10,350 m and the world edge, and the edge is not a wall — sail too far past it and you fall into the void and lose everything on the boat.

steps: Fish each species in turn — the list spans the Meadows through the Ashlands and Deep North.
Every fish must be landed by reeling it in on the rod; picking one up by hand does not register.
Use the matching bait for each biome and upgrade your Fishing skill so rarer species bite at all.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Ashlands fish only take Hot bait — grabbing the wrong bait there wastes a lot of time before the line even moves.
Reddit tip: Running a character with a high Fishing skill and no other goal is the fastest way to knock this out, since every rare fish needs a skill threshold.

achievements.name: The Gourmet
achievements.description: Eat every kind of edible item.

steps: Eat one of every edible item in the game, including raw and cooked versions, berries, mushrooms, fish and every mead.
Keep a checklist of what is still missing and test unusual drops as you pick them up.
Pair it with The Master Chef and The Fisherman — cooking and catching each species feeds this achievement too.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Several meads sit behind boss drops and Ashlands farming, so this cannot be finished before the Ashlands is explored.
Reddit tip: Eating is free — there is no downside to testing every food item you come across as you play.

steps: Kill at least one of every creature type — hostile and passive creatures both count.
Sweep each biome deliberately rather than relying on normal play, and check your statistics to see what is still missing.
If you plan a Hard run afterwards, do it on that character so The Master Hunter comes for free.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Tamed animals count — friendly fire lets you kill boars, deer and greylings without building a farm full of pens.
Reddit tip: Several creatures only appear at night or in Ashlands storms, so a daylight sweep alone will leave gaps.

achievements.name: The Legends Are True
achievements.description: Sail over the edge of the world.

steps: Take a boat outward past the world edge — roughly 10,420 m from centre, about 70 m beyond the 10,350 m Explorer threshold.
Keep going until you actually fall off and die; simply reaching or touching the edge does not trigger it.
The achievement fires on that death, after which you can respawn — set up a Portal on shore first so you are not stranded.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the same trip as The Explorer and The Pathfinder — stack all three on one voyage to the edge.
Reddit tip: Dying off the world edge also ticks the falling-off-the-world death cause in Are You Alright?, so it counts twice.
Reddit tip: Place a Portal on the shore before you leave, otherwise you are stranded with no way back except swimming.
warnings: You cannot recover the items on the boat once you go over the edge — travel light or leave your gear at a Portal.
The world has no invisible wall, so it is very easy to fall off by accident while doing The Explorer.

steps: Chop 500 trees in total — the counter keeps climbing across every session and every biome.
Use your best available axe, upgraded to the highest tier you have, to make the chopping fast.
Cutting trees for wood and for The Builder overlap, so ordinary gathering carries most of the count.
Cook one of every food recipe in the game at a Cooking Station over a campfire.
Work from a checklist — several recipes need Ashlands and Deep North ingredients that are easy to overlook.
Repeat harvests are not required, but every distinct recipe has to be made at least once.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Set up a kitchen garden with all the ingredients you can grow so you can batch-cook dozens of recipes in one session.
Reddit tip: Multiple Cooking Stations on one campfire lets you run several recipes in parallel and clear this much faster.
warnings: The Cook achievement needs 100 total dishes while this one needs every distinct recipe — the second does not replace the first.

achievements.name: The Master Hunter
achievements.description: Kill every kind of creature on hard difficulty.

steps: Start or join a world with the combat difficulty set to Hard or Very Hard before the kills register.
Kill every creature type on that character, including friendly creatures.
Enable friendly fire if you plan to kill creatures you have tamed, otherwise boars and deer cannot be finished off.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You can weaken a boss on an easier difficulty, leave, then switch to Hard and land the kill — it counts as a Hard kill. Much easier than clearing the whole game on Hard.
Reddit tip: Selecting the Hard preset and then adjusting Death Penalty, Resource Rate, Portals, No Build Cost and Passive Enemies is allowed and still counts as a Hard world.
warnings: Kills made before switching the world to Hard do not count for this achievement.
This is a prerequisite for Child of Odin, so it forces a Hard playthrough regardless of your plans.

achievements.name: The Pathfinder
achievements.description: Travel far in all four directions, without using a map.

steps: Create or join a world with the No Map world modifier enabled.
Reach the same 10,350 m cardinal threshold toward the north edge without opening the map, then repeat for south, east and west.
All four legs use their own separate No Map counters, so each must be travelled independently.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You can cheese it — reach each world edge on a normal world, then briefly toggle the No Map modifier on at that edge so the game registers the stat.
Reddit tip: Steer by compass and landmarks only. Opening the map will not corrupt the counters, it just does not advance them.
warnings: Without the map you cannot see how close the edge is — expect to overshoot and fall into the void.
Three achievements in this set are gated on world modifiers rather than difficulty: The Tough Viking and The Toughest Viking on combat difficulty, and this one on No Map.
This is a prerequisite for Child of Odin.

achievements.name: The Tough Viking
achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on normal difficulty or higher.

steps: Set the world to Normal, Hard or Very Hard combat difficulty before you start the boss run — all three qualify.
Defeat all 8 bosses: Eikthyr, The Elder, Bonemass, Moder, Yagluth, The Seeker Queen, Fader and Kall Fimbulbringer.
All kills must be on the same character, and they can be completed alongside The Toughest Viking.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: A full Hard run clears The Viking, The Tough Viking and The Toughest Viking at once, so pick Hard if you were undecided.
Reddit tip: Hammer Mode kills do not count toward this achievement.

achievements.name: The Toughest Viking
achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on hard difficulty.

steps: Create or join a world with the combat difficulty set to Hard or Very Hard — both presets qualify.
Defeat all 8 bosses on that character, gearing up with Ashlands and Deep North gear before the late fights.
The same run also satisfies The Viking and The Tough Viking.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Start Hard after your character is already geared rather than from scratch — several bosses are near-impossible with bronze.
Reddit tip: Weakening a boss on an easier world, then switching to Hard for the kill, is confirmed to count as a Hard kill.

Reddit tip: Hard and Very Hard are presets that bundle several modifiers. Death Penalty, Resource Rate, Portals, No Build Cost and Passive Enemies can all be adjusted afterwards without losing the Hard classification.
warnings: Kall Fimbulbringer on Hard is the hardest single fight in the game — expect repeated attempts.
Difficulty is not one dropdown but a set of independent modifiers; make sure the combat difficulty is actually set before the kills register.
This is a prerequisite for Child of Odin, so it forces a Hard playthrough on one character.

steps: Equip a Wishbone — Bonemass drops one — which pings with rising green puffs and an accelerating sound as you approach a hidden secret.
Follow the ping to the marked spot, then dig it up with a pickaxe or break it with a hammer.
Open the chest and repeat until you have found 10 distinct buried treasures; they spawn in the Meadows grass.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Wishbone also detects Muddy Scrap Piles in the Swamp and silver veins in the Mountains, but only buried treasure chests count toward this achievement.
Reddit tip: Kill Bonemass early on a character you are keeping, because the Wishbone is what makes finding them fast.
warnings: The Wishbone stops detecting a secret once you have opened it, so you need 10 separate buried treasures — re-looting one chest will not get you there.
Pre-generated chests from the world generator, including Ashlands Charred Chests, Mistlands Dvergr Treasure Chests and Deep North chests, do not count.

steps: Collect one trophy from every creature that drops one — the list runs to dozens of entries across all biomes.
Track progress against a checklist, since there is no in-game counter for individual trophies.
Kill creatures deliberately rather than letting them die to the environment, which does not always award the trophy.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Pair this with The Hunter on a Hard world so each creature is killed once for both achievements.
Reddit tip: Several trophies only drop from bosses and rare spawns, so leave those until late rather than hunting them piecemeal.
warnings: The game gives no partial-progress display for this one, so keep your own list — it feels complete long before it is.

steps: Build on a high-altitude location such as a mountain peak, then stack upward until the placed piece reaches an altitude of at least 432 m.
Support the column with at least 5 building pieces directly below the new piece, with more than 45% of them built by you.
Type /pos in chat to check your current altitude and keep climbing until you clear the target.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Start from the highest terrain you can find and stack upward — this measures absolute altitude, so Mighty Halls alone will not get you there.
Reddit tip: Interior and dungeon placements do not count for this stat, so build in the open world on a mountain.
warnings: Building this high costs an enormous amount of materials and takes a long time — plan a resource stockpile first.
Do not confuse this with Mighty Halls, which measures height above terrain rather than altitude. The two are independent objectives and neither one covers the other.
Some community guides state 492 m; the game files and the official wiki both say 432 m. Building higher is harmless, so 492+ is a safe margin.
